bio.text: Missi Hesketh is the Democratic candidate for Missouri's 7th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election; she was unopposed in the August primary.
She was mayor of Forsyth, Missouri, when she ran for the same seat in 2024.
According to KSMU, citing Ballotpedia, she earned a bachelor's degree in elementary education from the University of Missouri-St. Louis and a graduate degree from Drury University.

sources.title: Incumbent U.S. 7th District Representative Eric Burlison defeats challengers Grayson Hunt and John Casey in the Republican Primary
